name: Riverfront Pediatric Dentistry
toddlerFit: Best overall toddler evidence. Reviews specifically describe successful visits for children around ages two to four, including anxious first visits.
negativeReviewSummary: Google's distribution showed only two one-star, one two-star, and one three-star rating among hundreds of reviews. The accessible Google and Yelp material did not show a repeated clinical or administrative complaint.

name: Bergen Pediatric Dentistry
toddlerFit: The closest specialist. Strong evidence for patient, low-pressure care, including children with autism, anxiety, or special needs.
negativeReviewSummary: One older Yelp reviewer described repeated negative experiences for their child, but provided few specifics. I did not find the same clinical theme repeated across Google Maps reviews.

name: Say Cheez Pediatric Dentistry & Orthodontics
toddlerFit: Dedicated infant-and-toddler care, child-themed rooms, ceiling TVs, and strong praise for patient and conservative treatment.
negativeReviewSummary: The Google Maps distribution contained one one-star rating and one four-star rating among 363 reviews. I found no substantive or repeated negative theme in the accessible review text.

name: Ridgewood Valley Pediatric Dentistry
toddlerFit: A smaller pediatric practice with relevant positive reports from families bringing children ages one and three.
negativeReviewSummary: No meaningful recurring complaint surfaced in the accessible Google Maps, Healthgrades, or Facebook review material. The review set is smaller and somewhat older than the Tier 1 choices.

name: Glen Rock Smiles Pediatric Dentistry & Orthodontics
acceptsNewPatients: Yes — new pediatric appointments invited online
toddlerFit: Explicitly treats ages zero to two and describes a quick, non-invasive first visit focused on comfort, diet, brushing, and habits.
negativeReviewSummary: I found no repeated negative theme in accessible Google Maps or Yelp-indexed material. The overall evidence base is smaller than the highest-volume practices.

name: Pediatric Dental Associates
acceptsNewPatients: Yes — new-patient forms and appointments available
toddlerFit: The largest review base, long weekday hours, Saturday appointments, and consistent praise for gentle care and calming frightened children.
negativeReviewSummary: No repeated negative pattern appeared in the accessible Google Maps, Healthgrades, or other indexed reviews. The displayed 5.0 is rounded and should not be interpreted as literally zero dissatisfied patients.

name: SmileKidz Pediatric Dentistry & Braces
toddlerFit: Board-certified pediatric care with Saturday hours and especially strong feedback on friendliness, efficiency, and making visits fun.
negativeReviewSummary: Google Maps showed one one-star rating and two four-star ratings among 461. The lone low rating did not produce a corroborated complaint pattern in accessible review text.

name: Dental Care 4 Kids
toddlerFit: Treats infants and children with special healthcare needs. Extensive weekday hours and Saturday availability offset the longer drive.
negativeReviewSummary: One Yelp reviewer mentioned a small billing discrepancy and said it was resolved promptly. I did not find a consistent NJ-specific clinical complaint across Google Maps and Yelp.

name: Dentistry for Children of Lodi
acceptsNewPatients: Yes — online booking for new patients
toddlerFit: Board-certified pediatric specialists with dedicated guidance for babies and toddlers and broad insurance participation.
negativeReviewSummary: Several Google Maps and community reviews describe front-desk disorganization, rude interactions, or long waits. One recent reviewer was checked in but later marked as a no-show. These are specific operational complaints, not merely impatience, but I found no recurring clinical-safety theme.

name: Pediatric Dentistry of Teaneck
toddlerFit: Large clinical team with Saturday appointments. Dentists receive substantial positive feedback, but office operations are the main tradeoff.
negativeReviewSummary: Multiple independent Google Maps and Facebook reviews describe unanswered phones, difficult billing, insurance errors, cancellations, and rude reception. One lateness dispute partly involved the family arriving late, but the wider administrative pattern is credible. I found no equally clear recurring clinical-safety pattern.
